quotations.old_english: Ic eom getogen tó fremdum þeáwum ðurh ða ungefyldan (-gefylledan, Cott. MS.) gítsunge woruldmonna
quotations.latin: nos ad constantiam, nostris moribus alienam, inexpleta hominum cupiditas alligabit?

source_text: un-gefylled; adj. Unfilled, unsatisfied :-- Ic eom getogen tó fremdum þeáwum ðurh ða ungefyldan (-gefylledan, Cott. MS.) gítsunge woruldmonna nos ad constantiam, nostris moribus alienam, inexpleta hominum cupiditas alligabit? Bt. 7, 3; Fox 20, 26.
